toolsPreview.name: inkflow_capabilities
toolsPreview.description: INKFLOW's full catalogue: complete full-length books (45k up to 900,000-word COLOSSAL editions, every genre, 22 languages written natively), multi-volume series with automatic continuity bibles, manuals/SOPs/technical specs, and ULTRA-trained LoRA digital actors (.safetensors, rank-64, for AI video production) with persistent-world object LoRAs. Returns products, tiers, genres, languages and live prices in the requested currency. Machine-audited quality on every chapter; typical novel delivered in under 24 hours. (Book-to-movie episodic adaptation is in development and not currently orderable.)

toolsPreview.name: inkflow_quote
toolsPreview.description: Firm price quote for a writing job WITHOUT ordering. 3x-margin fixed pricing; quotes honoured for 24h.

toolsPreview.name: inkflow_order
toolsPreview.description: Place a paid order for a complete book, manual, technical spec, or multi-volume series. Returns a Stripe payment URL — writing starts automatically the moment payment clears, with per-chapter progress via inkflow_job_status and webhooks. Requires your INKFLOW apiKey (register at https://inkflowstudio.org).

toolsPreview.name: inkflow_train_ultra_lora_actor
toolsPreview.description: Commission a custom ULTRA-trained LoRA digital actor for AI video production: a 4,500+ step rank-64 multi-reference identity model (.safetensors) holding the same face from every angle. You receive the LoRA file, a verified multi-pose reference pack and a perpetual commercial license. Original synthetic person — never a real likeness. After ordering you get 3 candidate thumbnails; training starts only after you choose a face (inkflow_choose_actor_face). $48 flat.

toolsPreview.name: inkflow_choose_actor_face
toolsPreview.description: Pick one of the 3 candidate thumbnails for a digital-actor order — ULTRA LoRA training starts on your chosen face.

toolsPreview.name: inkflow_free_samples
toolsPreview.description: FREE, no key needed: sample ULTRA LoRA actor cards (multi-pose stills) and object/set LoRA renders, and product spec sheets — see the quality before ordering anything.

toolsPreview.name: inkflow_job_status
toolsPreview.description: Live status of an order: chapters written, QA phase, delivery links when complete.
